node.title: Re: Display text and image on same page
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The tag's src needs to be a URL, not a filename on the server. So it depends on what your webserver is configured to use as the document root - i.e. which directory on the server files are served from when the user visits http://www.example.com/. If the document root is for example /var/www, then you could maybe use (although depending on how your site is set up, relative URLs might be better).

By the way, it'd be better if you didn't generate HTML like this. I recommend you look into e.g. [mod://HTML::Tiny], [mod://Template::Toolkit], or maybe even a web framework, such as [mod://Mojolicious].
